es: Reconocer el registro informal, neutro o formal de un mensaje y los rasgos de saludo, petición y cierre que lo delatan, y distinguir lo coloquial de la jerga.

vocabulary.es: tratarse por el nombre de pila

teaching.en: Hey Sam, could you lend me your notes from the lecture? Honestly, cheers for being so quick about it last time; you saved me.
teaching.es: Oye, Sam, ¿me prestas tus apuntes de la clase? En serio, gracias por ser tan rápido la última vez; me salvaste.
teaching.explanationEs: Hey y cheers marcan un registro informal, propio de amigos.

cheers for being so quick about it last time; you saved me.
teaching.audioText: Hey Sam, could you lend me your notes from the lecture? Honestly, cheers for being so quick about it last time; you saved me.

teaching.en: Hello Mrs Kent, could you look at the heating this week? I would be grateful, as the flat has been cold for days.
teaching.es: Hola, señora Kent, ¿podría revisar la calefacción esta semana? Se lo agradecería, ya que el piso lleva días frío.
teaching.explanationEs: Could you + I would be grateful: registro neutro y cortés, apto para alguien a quien conoces poco.
segments: Hello Mrs Kent, could you look at the heating this week? I
would be grateful, as the flat has been cold for days.

teaching.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding my booking for flight 204, and I would be grateful for a prompt reply.
teaching.es: Estimados señores: les escribo con respecto a mi reserva del vuelo 204 y les agradecería una respuesta rápida.
teaching.explanationEs: Dear Sir or Madam e I am writing regarding son marcas formales, típicas de una carta a una empresa.

teaching.en: Between friends you say sorry about that, but with a company you switch register: please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.
teaching.es: Entre amigos se dice «perdona por eso», pero con una empresa se cambia de registro: acepte nuestras disculpas por las molestias.
teaching.explanationEs: Switch register es adaptar el nivel de formalidad al lector; inconvenience es la molestia causada.
segments: Between friends you say sorry about that, but with a company
you switch register: please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.
teaching.audioText: Between friends you say sorry about that, but with a company you switch register: please accept our apologies for the inconvenience.

teaching.en: It is hard to strike the right tone: «Kindly confirm receipt» is correct, but between colleagues it can come across as stiff.
teaching.es: Es difícil dar con el tono adecuado: «Kindly confirm receipt» es correcto, pero entre compañeros puede resultar rígido.
teaching.explanationEs: Kindly + imperativo es muy formal; stiff describe lo demasiado oficial para la situación.
segments: It is hard to strike the right tone: «Kindly confirm receipt»
is correct, but between colleagues it can come across as stiff.

teaching.en: Ana is on first-name terms with her landlady, so she can be colloquial, but she still tries to avoid slang in writing.
teaching.es: Ana se trata por el nombre de pila con su casera, así que puede usar un estilo coloquial, pero aun así procura evitar la jerga al escribir.
teaching.explanationEs: Colloquial es lo propio de la conversación cotidiana; slang es jerga, más marcada aún. Amistoso no significa informal del todo.

prompt.es: Clasifica el registro de este mensaje por su saludo, su petición y su cierre.

choices.text: Neutral: polite greeting, softened request, standard closing
Informal: friendly greeting, direct request, casual closing
Formal: official opening, long request, traditional closing

feedback.es: Hey, una petición directa con can you y Cheers son las tres marcas del registro informal entre amigos.

hint.es: Mira cómo empieza, cómo pide y cómo termina el mensaje.

origin.text: Hey Leo, can you send me the photos from Saturday? They looked amazing! Cheers, Ana

prompt.es: Completa: «Les escribo con respecto a mi reserva del vuelo 204.»

feedback.es: Regarding es la forma formal de «con respecto a» y va directamente seguido del nombre.

hint.es: Es la palabra formal para «con respecto a».

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing ___ my booking for flight 204. I would be grateful for a prompt reply.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con el registro o la función que marca.

pairs: I would be grateful if you could…

feedback.es: Cada fórmula es una pista: saludo coloquial, saludo oficial, petición cortés o disculpa breve.

hint.es: Piensa a quién se lo escribirías.

pairs: I would be grateful if you could…

prompt.es: ¿Qué registro tiene este mensaje a una casera?

choices.text: Informal: close, joking and full of slang.
Formal: distant, official and legal in style.
Neutral: friendly but careful, with no slang.

feedback.es: Hi con el apellido, could we y una petición cortés forman un registro neutro y cercano, sin jerga ni fórmulas oficiales.

origin.text: Hi Mrs Kent, thanks for the flowers you left by the door! Could we talk about the rent on Friday? I'd be grateful if the heating could be checked then too.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige a quién se dirige la persona y con qué actitud.

choices.text: A company, politely and formally.
A friend, casually and warmly.
A neighbour, bluntly and with slang.

feedback.es: Good afternoon, regarding, unfortunately y I would be grateful son marcas formales propias de quien se dirige a una empresa.

origin.audio: Good afternoon. I am calling regarding my booking for flight 204. Unfortunately, I have not had a reply to my earlier message, so I would be grateful if you could call me back by Friday. Thank you for your time.

prompt.es: Completa: «Escribo a mi casera por lo de la calefacción.»

feedback.es: Landlady es la mujer que alquila una vivienda: la casera o propietaria.

origin.text: We are on first-name terms, but I am still writing to my ___ about the heating in a neutral tone.

prompt.es: Clasifica el registro de este mensaje y al destinatario más probable.

choices.text: Neutral, sent to a helpful neighbour
Formal, sent to an airline's customer team
Informal, sent to a close friend

feedback.es: Dear Sir or Madam, regarding, I would be grateful y Kind regards forman un mensaje formal dirigido a una empresa.

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding my refund for flight 204, which I requested three weeks ago. Despite your promise that it would be paid within ten days, I have not yet received anything, although I sent you my booking number and the original receipt twice. I would be grateful if you could look into the matter and let me know, by Friday, when I can expect the money. Please accept my thanks in advance for your help. Kind regards, Sara Ortiz

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud transmite Sara a pesar de su tono cortés?

choices.text: Warm and friendly towards the airline staff.
Calm about whether she is ever paid.
Polite but firm: she expects something to happen.

feedback.es: Recuerda que prometieron pagar en diez días y fija un plazo (by Friday): es cortés, pero deja clara su impaciencia.

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding my refund for flight 204, which I requested three weeks ago. Despite your promise that it would be paid within ten days, I have not yet received anything, although I sent you my booking number and the original receipt twice. I would be grateful if you could look into the matter and let me know, by Friday, when I can expect the money. Please accept my thanks in advance for your help. Kind regards, Sara Ortiz

prompt.es: Escucha y elige los rasgos que delatan el registro del mensaje.

choices.text: A casual greeting, a loose request and a relaxed closing.
A title and family name, a tentative request and a formal sign-off.
An official opening, a long request and a traditional sign-off.

feedback.es: Hey, una petición suelta y Cheers son rasgos informales; no hay título, fórmulas de cortesía ni cierre oficial.

origin.audio: Hey Leo, it's Sam. Are you around later? I've got two tickets for Friday's game and, to be honest, I'd love for you to come along. Just text me back when you can, no rush. Cheers!

prompt.es: Completa: «Acepte nuestras disculpas por las molestias causadas por el retraso.»

feedback.es: Inconvenience es la molestia causada; es la palabra habitual en disculpas formales de empresas.

origin.text: Your flight was delayed for four hours. Please accept our apologies for the ___ caused by the delay.

prompt.es: ¿Qué hace que este mensaje resulte inadecuado para un profesor?

choices.text: Its request is too indirect for anyone to understand it.
Its casual greeting, slang and closing clash with the reader.
Its apology is excessive for such a small delay.

feedback.es: El saludo coloquial, la jerga y Cheers chocan con un lector que merece respeto: el registro no encaja con el destinatario.

origin.text: Hi Prof, hope you're good. So I kinda missed the deadline, sorry! Could you give me until Monday? It'd be great. Cheers, Leo

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué da a entender la estudiante sobre su excusa.

choices.text: That she blames the library for everything.
That she wants the essay marked without changes.
That she knows her reason may not justify the delay.

feedback.es: «Which I realise is no excuse» muestra que reconoce que su razón puede no bastar, sin culpar a nadie.

origin.audio: Dear Ms Brown, I was wondering whether I could hand in my essay on Monday instead. I am afraid the library was closed all week, which I realise is no excuse. I would be very grateful for your understanding.

prompt.es: Completa: «Entre dos compañeros, la misma frase puede sonar rígida y distante.»

feedback.es: Stiff describe lo demasiado oficial o acartonado para la situación.

origin.text: In a formal letter, «Kindly confirm receipt» is correct, but between two colleagues the same sentence can sound ___ and distant.
